content: इद् {%ind.%} .²1 A particle of affirmation, even, just, only; यथा वशन्ति देवास्तथेदसद् <ls>Rv. 8. 28. 4</ls> especially in strengthening a statement; अर्थज्ञ इत्सकलं भद्रमश्नुते <ls>Nir.</ls> .²2 It is often added to words expressing excess or exclusion: विश्व इत् एक इत् <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 At the beginning of sentences it often adds emphasis to pronouns, prepositions <ab>&c.</ab> (its place is taken by एव in classical Sanskrit).
